items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: That's the time when, uh, Albert Walters took sick, he was on that job. He took sick, and he got John Penny. And one time we had sports, Sun Johnson, and, and, uh, John Handley. Three alto saxophone, working at Taxi Dance.

ctx.x: He don't play trumpet no more. Yeah, Albert Walters.
You know him. Oh, he don't play Albert Walters.
Yeah, he's a good trumpet player.
